notes: The manual gives two alternative circuits (potentiometer OR photoresistor + 10k resistor). I modelled the potentiometer circuit; the photoresistor variant (5V -> LDR -> A0 node -> 10k resistor -> GND) is not included.

The breadboard images are drawn flipped relative to the catalogue naming: the image's lower half (rows a-e) is mapped to bank 't' and the upper half (rows f-j) to bank 'b'. Pot legs: GND at 10t.e, VCC at 12t.e; wiper pin points into the upper half at 11b.f.
Red wire goes from 5V to the pot's right outer pin (12t.c); black wire from the second GND header pin to the pot's left outer pin (10t.c); yellow wire from A0 to the wiper (11b.g).

The optional external LED circuit (220 ohm resistor + red LED on pin 13, cathode to GND next to pin 13) is described only in text; its breadboard placement (columns 20-25) and the use of GND.3 for the GND next to pin 13 are my assumptions. The built-in LED on pin 13 is part of the Uno and not a separate node.
The Arduino is assumed to be powered via USB, which is not shown in the images.
